violations.msg: reference-kickback.cir: first_droop_uv = 16.3522 outside <= 15.6 - FINDING, EXPECTED TO FIRE, AND HANDED TO THE ARCHITECT. VREF droop across the FIRST conversion after an idle period - the one case where the node starts fully recovered, so the whole per-conversion charge comes out of the bulk. Measured 16.35 uV against blocks.md s7 item 5's 15.6 uV figure: 1.05x over, i.e. 1.05 LSB-halves. It is a WARNING and not an error because s7 item 5 states its 15.6 uV as a RECOVERY criterion (ref_recov_uv, which passes at 0.0014 uV), and intra-conversion droop is a different quantity that no cited source bounds on this board. Three things the architect needs with it: (1) it applies to the first conversion after idle only - repetitive operation sees 4.75 uV; (2) the droop is monotonic across the bit trials, so the code error is a fraction of the raw droop (the MSB decisions happen before the droop develops) - that fraction is NOT quantified here; (3) the remedy is bounded, because more bulk is the only lever and the ADR4520 ceiling is 100 uF total, so the best available is 49.2 -> ~100 uF, which halves it to ~8.5 uV. Not sensitive to the unpublished reference output impedance: 16.35 uV at 5 ohm, 17.33 uV at 50 ohm, saturating at droop_caplimit_uv.
